items.q: Where do the light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis take place?
items.qAf: Waar vind die ligafhanklike reaksies van fotosintese plaas?
items.explain: Light is absorbed by chlorophyll in the thylakoid membranes, where ATP and NADPH are made.
items.explainAf: Lig word deur chlorofil in die tilakoïedmembrane geabsorbeer, waar ATP en NADPH gemaak word.

items.q: Which gas is released as a by-product of the light-dependent reactions?
items.qAf: Watter gas word as ’n byproduk van die ligafhanklike reaksies vrygestel?
items.explain: Water is split (photolysis) and oxygen is released.
items.explainAf: Water word gesplits (fotolise) en suurstof word vrygestel.

items.q: The Calvin cycle uses ATP and NADPH from the light reactions to:
items.qAf: Die Calvin-siklus gebruik ATP en NADPH van die ligreaksies om:
optionsAf: koolstofdioksied in suiker vas te lê
items.explain: The Calvin cycle in the stroma fixes CO₂ into glucose using the energy carriers.
items.explainAf: Die Calvin-siklus in die stroma vas CO₂ in glukose vas deur die energiedraers te gebruik.

items.q: At very low light intensity, what limits the rate of photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Wat beperk die tempo van fotosintese by baie lae ligintensiteit?
items.explain: When light is the lowest available factor, increasing other factors does not raise the rate.
items.explainAf: Wanneer lig die laagste beskikbare faktor is, verhoog ander faktore nie die tempo nie.

items.q: What is the effect of very high temperature on the enzymes of photosynthesis?
items.qAf: Wat is die effek van baie hoë temperatuur op die ensieme van fotosintese?
options: They denature and the rate falls
optionsAf: Hulle denatureer en die tempo daal
items.explain: High temperatures denature the enzymes, so the rate drops sharply.
items.explainAf: Hoë temperature denatureer die ensieme, dus daal die tempo skerp.

items.q: Plant A is in light of 500 units. Doubling light to 1000 units doubles the rate, but at 2000 the rate stays the same. What is the limiting factor at 2000 units?
items.qAf: Plant A is in lig van 500 eenhede. Verdubbeling van lig na 1000 eenhede verdubbel die tempo, maar by 2000 bly die tempo dieselfde. Wat is die beperkende faktor by 2000 eenhede?
options: Another factor such as CO₂ or temperature
optionsAf: ’n Ander faktor soos CO₂ of temperatuur
items.explain: Once light is no longer limiting, the rate is limited by another factor.
items.explainAf: Sodra lig nie meer beperkend is nie, word die tempo deur ’n ander faktor beperk.

items.q: The stage of photosynthesis in which light energy splits water molecules.
items.qAf: Die fase van fotosintese waarin ligenergie watermolekules verdeel.

items.q: The splitting of water by light energy.
items.qAf: Die verdeling van water deur ligenergie.

items.q: A factor that is in shortest supply and so limits the rate of photosynthesis.
items.qAf: ’n Faktor wat die kleinste hoeveelheid beskikbaar is en dus die tempo van fotosintese beperk.

items.q: The stacks of thylakoids inside a chloroplast.

items.text: The dark phase (Calvin cycle) takes place in the [[]] of the chloroplast, where carbon dioxide is used to make [[]].
items.textAf: Die donker fase (Calvin-siklus) vind in die [[]] van die chloroplas plaas, waar koolstofdioksied gebruik word om [[]] te maak.

items.q: The oxygen released in photosynthesis comes from water.
items.qAf: Die suurstof wat in fotosintese vrygestel word, kom uit water.
items.explain: True. Photolysis splits water into hydrogen and oxygen; the oxygen is released.
items.explainAf: Waar. Fotolise verdeel water in waterstof en suurstof; die suurstof word vrygestel.

items.q: Increasing the light intensity always increases the rate of photosynthesis.
items.qAf: Om die ligintensiteit te verhoog, verhoog altyd die tempo van fotosintese.
items.explain: False. Above a certain point another factor (CO₂ or temperature) becomes limiting and the rate levels off.
items.explainAf: Onwaar. Bo ’n sekere punt word ’n ander faktor (CO₂ of temperatuur) beperkend en die tempo plat af.

items.q: Explain why farmers often add carbon dioxide and use lights in greenhouses.
items.qAf: Verduidelik waarom boere dikwels koolstofdioksied byvoeg en ligte in kweekhuise gebruik.
points: Carbon dioxide and light are limiting factors of photosynthesis.
Increasing them increases the rate of photosynthesis, so the crops grow faster and give a higher yield.
pointsAf: Koolstofdioksied en lig is beperkende faktore van fotosintese.
Om hulle te verhoog, verhoog die tempo van fotosintese, dus groei die gewasse vinniger en lewer ’n hoër oes.

items.q: Describe how you would show that light is needed for photosynthesis.
items.qAf: Beskryf hoe jy sou wys dat lig vir fotosintese nodig is.
points: De-starch a potted plant by keeping it in the dark for 48 hours.
Cover part of a leaf with foil and put the plant in light for some hours.
Test the leaf with iodine: only the uncovered part turns blue-black (contains starch).
pointsAf: Ontstysel ’n potplant deur dit vir 48 uur in die donker te hou.
Bedek ’n deel van ’n blaar met foelie en plaas die plant vir ’n paar uur in lig.
Toets die blaar met jodium: net die onbedekte deel word blouswart (bevat stysel).
